name: Summer☆Salt ~Doutei to Shojo no Fuufu~
original_name: さまぁ☆ソルト~童貞と処女の夫婦~
source: The protagonist, Isshiki Kazuto, was heartbroken after his failed relationship with the widow Touko. The one who helped him was Misao, who had once been rejected by him. Misao devotedly supported Kazuto, who aspired to become a teacher, and eventually the two got married. They lived a happy married life, but the story didn't end there.
translation: 主人公一色和人因与寡妇灯子的失败关系而伤心欲绝。帮助他的人是曾经被他拒绝过的美佐绪。美佐绪全力支持立志成为一名教师的和人，最终两人结婚了。他们的婚姻生活很幸福，但故事并没有结束。
